phase: TRELLIS.2 follow-up, separate from completed TripoSR probe
hosted_weights_provenance: Space code declares model ID without a revision pin. Observed model repo tip is not proof of loaded server weights.
preprocessing: Official /preprocess_image, BRIA-RMBG-2.0, square crop and black compositing; inspect actual returned image before generation. No second preprocessing of the processed PNG.
retry_rule: No repeated quota requests unchanged, no seed search, no fallback model. At most one separately recorded corrective reattempt can be considered only after a proven pre-inference client/API error and an independently justified fix. Unknown timeout outcome is not permission to generate again.
use_contract: Same visible front cabin door, coherent frame/glass/handle/lining, 0/30/60 degree poses, fixed other parts, convincing recognizable car in 1440x960 hero/side views and exposed-edge/cabin close-up.
timing_clarification: Two seconds opening plus two seconds closing, matching the actual prior demonstration; pose targets are unchanged. Historical phrase 'two-second open/close' is ambiguous and this clarification is explicit.
conventional_preparation: Asset-specific selection/hinge; preserve UVs/textures/PBR/materials and normals; allow local remesh/material repairs and plausible interior completion. Do not reuse TripoSR vertex-color reconstruction scripts unchanged.
preparation_budget: If a candidate is obtained, one documented preparation and at most two targeted local corrections addressing identified defects, then final review; no whole-car replacement/repainting or unlimited cosmetic campaign.
measurements: untouched exported GLB plus native preview
import-export appearance check before substantive preparation
0/30/60 degree plus trajectory and reversible return, fixed body
selected moving surface with completion hidden/enabled
technical visual review separate from motion validity; artist acceptance unmeasured without an artist
checkpoint_rule: Verify initial contract/code/input checkpoint before hosted preprocessing; verify processed image checkpoint before generation; preserve and externally checkpoint any generation preview before separate GPU export; checkpoint returned GLB before authoring.
server_latent_limit: API exposes HTML and GLB, but not server-held gr.State shape/texture latents. Do not pretend unexposed latents are backed up. Keep the same live client for export and disclose inaccessible intermediates.
comparisons: Prior TripoSR remains a historical same-input/task comparator, not a controlled cross-generator statistical comparison. No static-preview task substitution.
stopping: If access/resource/export genuinely blocks the run, retain exact errors and state, distinguish inference from export, report minimum enabling requirement and no asset-quality conclusion.
